evidence.title: GitHub - asiffer/mkdocs-shadcn: Documentation that also shines

name: mkdocs-shadcn
summary: MkDocs theme bringing the shadcn/ui style to documentation sites, plus tabs, admonitions, charts and diagrams.
description: An unofficial MkDocs theme that applies shadcn/ui styling to documentation sites; the project's own docs are built with it. It supports built-in MkDocs and pymdownx extensions (admonition, tabbed, blocks details and tab, progressbar, arithmatex, footnotes, codehilite) and plugins for Excalidraw editing, mkdocstrings API docs, mike versioning and a custom autonumber plugin. Ships ECharts and Iconify integrations (shadcn.echarts, shadcn.iconify) and publishes its Tailwind-based CSS sources. Installable with pip; ProperDocs works as a drop-in replacement. MIT licensed.
contains: supports pymdownx tabs, details blocks, admonitions, progress bars and arithmatex
pip install; works with ProperDocs as drop-in replacement
